rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty about TE quality and claims features like uniform polygonal TE, symmetric ICM, and absence of debris/vacuolization that are not clearly discernible in this single image.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, male factor, endometrium, and transfer timing well, though it somewhat overinterprets AMH as implying better euploidy and adds speculative sperm DNA fragmentation concerns.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis, but some quantitative adjustments are speculative and there is mild overconfidence in how much AMH and prior live birth mitigate age/BMI effects.

Mostly aligned on eSET and general prognosis, but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin, ERA after a single failed transfer, and strong endorsement of PGT-A/embryo banking are more controversial or not universally guideline-supported.

Provides clear practical steps for transfer management and future planning, including eSET and lifestyle/metabolic considerations, though some suggestions are more aggressive than standard practice and would benefit from clearer conditional framing.
